title: Jesus Name Above All
lyrics_original: Lord I praise your nameJesus name above all namesJesus, name above all namesBeautiful Saviour, Glorious LordEmmanuel, God is with usBlessed Redeemer, Living WordBlessed Redeemer, Living WordBlessed Redeemer, Living Word

bible_verses.telugu: అందుచేతను పరలోకమందున్నవారిలో గాని, భూమిమీద ఉన్నవారిలో గాని,
bible_verses.english: Therefore God exalted him to the highest place and gave him the name that is above every name.

bible_verses.telugu: అని ప్రభువు తన ప్రవక్తద్వారా పలికిన మాట నెరవేరు నట్లు ఇదంతయు జరిగెను. ఇమ్మానుయేలను పేరునకు భాషాంతరమున దేవుడు మనకు తోడని అర్థము.
bible_verses.english: The virgin will conceive and give birth to a son, and they will call him Immanuel (which means 'God with us').

bible_verses.telugu: ఆదియందు వాక్యముండెను, వాక్యము దేవునియొద్ద ఉండెను, వాక్యము దేవుడై యుండెను.
bible_verses.english: In the beginning was the Word, and the Word was with God, and the Word was God.

devotional.prayer_english: Lord Jesus, Your name truly is above every other name in my life. Thank You for being my Emmanuel, drawing near to me in every season. Today, I lift up my praise to You, my Beautiful Savior and Blessed Redeemer. Help me to walk in the quiet peace of Your presence, trusting fully in the power of Your Living Word. Amen.
devotional.prayer_original: Lord Jesus, Your name truly is above every other name in my life. Thank You for being my Emmanuel, drawing near to me in every season. Today, I lift up my praise to You, my Beautiful Savior and Blessed Redeemer. Help me to walk in the quiet peace of Your presence, trusting fully in the power of Your Living Word. Amen.
devotional.reflection_english: When we speak the name of Jesus, we anchor our hearts in the fullness of who He is. He is not a distant deity, but Emmanuel—God intimately present with us in every moment. As our Blessed Redeemer and Living Word, His name carries divine comfort, hope, and authority over our lives. Singing these tender titles invites us to pause, surrender our worries, and simply rest in the beauty of His glorious presence.
